neighbours.label: Names of international organizations (UN, U.N., United Nations, WTO, IAEA, Naciones Unidas); the + pole is the other side, 'national/domestic'. Quiet on national or local bodies.
fire: The dispute over steel tariffs was taken to the WTO by several countries.
Observers from the United Nations monitored the ceasefire along the border.
The former U.N. envoy said the talks had reached a dead end.
Experts from the International Atomic Energy Agency inspected the site in March.
The sanctions were approved by the UN Security Council on Friday.
Las Naciones Unidas enviaron ayuda a la región afectada por el terremoto.
Under WTO rules, the subsidies were found to distort trade.
The treaty was registered with the United Nations after its signing.
quiet: The national parliament passed the budget after a long debate.
Domestic airlines raised their fares ahead of the holidays.
The country's nuclear regulator approved the new reactor design.
The state energy board set new rules for power companies.
The city council agreed to plant trees along the river.
The national football team arrived home to a large crowd.
The ministry of health opened three new clinics in rural areas.
El gobierno nacional anunció un nuevo plan de vivienda.

predictions: median fire ~0.6 (probes: IAEA Agency 0.47, U.N. 0.66, WTO 0.96, United Nations 0.57, Naciones Unidas 0.52); near misses < 0.04 (national government 0.033, country's Atomic Energy Commission 0.021, city council 0.008).
